notes: All four fan on/off pairs landed here at delta_va 33.9-49.1 VA: the sync-marker pulse (event_t_s 315 on / 331 off) and the three block cycles (536/618, 661/741, 782/863). One intruder: the charger's third block switch-on (delta_va 55.9 VA, event_t_s 1246) chained onto this cluster (55.9 - 49.1 = 6.8 VA < epsilonVa 12) and never got a matching cluster-1 off, so it is the "1 truncated cycle, 16.30 VA*h open at end of capture" line. ground_truth_cycles_in_cluster: 3 charger block cycles (6 events); only 4 events clustered here
notes: The charger's switching-supply signature spread its six block events across delta_va 55.9-101.1 VA. Four landed in this cluster near ~97 VA: on 1002, off 1083, off 1201, off 1320. That is one on and three offs, giving 1 complete cycle (block C1, operating time 81 s = 1083 - 1002) and 2 off-without-on discarded (block C2 and C3 offs). The two missing switch-ons: delta_va 69.8 VA (event_t_s 1127) fell between clusters and was dropped as noise; delta_va 55.9 VA (event_t_s 1246) was absorbed by cluster 1. Ground truth for the charger is 3 cycles over ~205 s; the cluster reports 1 cycle over 81 s, so this device's operating time and apparent energy underreport the charger by roughly 60 percent. Treat the underreport as the result.
power_factor_source: Hannagan et al. 2023, Sustainability 15(1):158 (switched-mode electronic load, midpoint of 0.47-0.63)

ground_truth_cycles_in_cluster: 4 sandwich-maker conductions (connection-artifact check + block cycles 1-3), all paired
notes: All four sandwich-maker on/off pairs landed here at delta_va 778.4-795.1 VA: the connection-artifact check conduction (event_t_s 84 on / 194 off) and the three block cycles (1650/1731, 1773/1835, 1885/1919). Operating time 287 s matches the sum exactly (110 + 81 + 62 + 34 s). No truncation, no unmatched events. Block cycle 3 was shorter (~34 s) because the element was still warm from cycles 1-2 and the thermostat cut it early; it still produced a clean paired event. This is the only cluster that is clean end to end.

The optional two-load simultaneous actuation (both switched on within ~2 s at 23:21:50, both off at 23:23:28) produced one merged switch-on (delta_va 113.9 VA, event_t_s 2156) and one merged switch-off (delta_va 121.9 VA, event_t_s 2256). Both are far from every cluster centre and there are only two of them, so DBSCAN leaves them as noise (cluster -1). The ~134.5 VA combined plateau ran ~87 s and its energy (~3.2 VA*h) is unattributed. Expected behaviour: near-simultaneous multi-load switching is not decomposed.
